item.title: Jaipur Rugs and Vimae1991 Bring to Life The Atelier Collection
item.description: Jaipur Rugs, reputed as India’s global leader in handcrafted carpets, in collaboration with Vimar1991, the Italian textile house owned by Chanel, has unveiled The “Atelier Collection”, a limited series of eight acrylic rugs that transform rare couture yarns into meticulously handcrafted works of art. item.title: A Pavilion Rooted in Ecology: Aranyani
item.description: Sacred Nature, the first Aranyani Pavilion in New Delhi, explores ecology, memory and restoration through its design. The pavilion, commissioned by Aranyani and designed by London-based Cypriot-Colombian practice T__M.space, is a structure that occupies a 600-square-metre site within Sunder Nursery, in New Delhi with a built footprint of 200 square metres. item.title: Beneath the Porticoes: UNStudio Reimagines Turin Metro
item.description: In Turin, a new metro line is being conceived by UNStudio not simply as transport, but as an extension of the city itself, drawing from its porticoes, landscapes, and patterns of movement to shape a contemporary public system.
